title: Discrepancy of a rectangle as an iterated integral
statement:
Fix $n$, work over the type $\mathrm{BoolInput}(n)$ of $n$-bit Boolean inputs equipped with a finite probability measure on the product $\mathrm{BoolInput}(n)\times\mathrm{BoolInput}(n)$, and let $\mathrm{IP}$ denote the mod-$2$ inner product. For any two subsets $A, B \subseteq \mathrm{BoolInput}(n)$, the discrepancy of $\mathrm{IP}$ on the combinatorial rectangle $A\times B$ factors as the iterated integral
\[
  \mathrm{disc}\bigl(\mathrm{IP},\, A\times B\bigr)
  = \int_{x} \mathbf{1}_A(x)\left(\int_{y} \mathbf{1}_B(y)\,\sigma\bigl(\mathrm{IP}(x,y)\bigr)\right),
\]
where $\mathbf{1}_A$ and $\mathbf{1}_B$ are the indicator functions of $A$ and $B$, and $\sigma$ is the Boolean sign map sending $\mathrm{false}\mapsto 1$ and $\mathrm{true}\mapsto -1$.
hypotheses_covered: finite probability space on the product BoolInput n × BoolInput n
discrepancy taken with respect to the inner product function IP
replaced:
For sets $A, B \subseteq \mathrm{BoolInput}\,n$, the discrepancy of the rectangle
$A \times B$ for the inner product function equals
\[
  \mathrm{disc}(\mathrm{IP}, A \times B)
  = \int_x \mathbf{1}_A(x)
      \int_y \mathbf{1}_B(y)\,\mathrm{boolSign}(\mathrm{IP}(x,y)).
\]
